Before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] owned a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed '''lightsaber'''. Secura wielded the lightsaber in the Battle of Geonosis and was one of the thirty Jedi who survived. Secura also wielded the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] when she [[Mission to Devaron|faced off]] against the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|fought]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], and continued to wield the weapon on other battlefronts. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight also used the weapon during battles on [[Quell/Legends|Quell]], [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]], and [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. Secura continued to use her lightsaber during [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] campaigns, until her [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where she was betrayed by the troops under her command and gunned down before she could defend herself. On some occasions, she would wield a green lightsaber in tandem with her primary blade, in order to apply her [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] skills in combat.
